text: and in this dock at the bottom lets just go ahead and get in there some more helpful things like we can store our in memory edit history here in a popover expand, we can also have things like average time per edit and these sorts of things i always want to monitor since when making a big ass map i need to see when it starts to increase the time of authoring because if it does thats how i know we have the wrong approach for the authoring tooling. im trying to ensure that a placement on an empty map is the same delta as a placement on a fully authored rich map
resolution: Expanded the bottom dock mock with an authoring telemetry popover. The dock now exposes in-memory edit count, average edit time, p95 edit time, rich-map delta, placement parity status, a compact cost sparkline, and per-event empty-map versus rich-map timings so authoring cost regressions are visible during map work.
